'''Peteen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] and [[High Seneschal/Legends|High Seneschal]] of the [[Bahk-tov Council/Legends|Bahk-tov Council]] and a member of the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] &mdash; led by [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] &mdash; during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As the leader of the Cult after Talzin, Peteen captured several of the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]], plus Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and Bardottan [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]].

He conducted the sacred ritual that worshiped the demon [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]] and stole the essence of the Dagoyan Masters. He also led the cultists to the [[Zardossa Stix Pyramid]] on [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]]. He was sacrificed when the temple blasted energy through five aligned lenses. All that remained was his mask.
